title: My dream & Juliet/Fat Ham 2 show day is gonna come true #broadway #fa...
transcript: we have breaking Broadway news from the drama bookshop today fat Ham is going to be doing a limited run at the American Airlines starting March 21st playing through August 6 this is the 6th Pulitzer Prize winning play that's coming to Broadway this season and this is my favorite I truly cannot wait I saw this earlier this year and it is one of my top 5 favorite performances of the year if you get a chance please go see this on Broadway
